questions.q: What is one benefit of Bitcoin over credit cards?
a: It removes middlemen and lowers transaction costs
It guarantees a stable and rising price
It lets banks verify every payment
It offers refunds when purchases fail
questions.why: Lesson 3 says Bitcoin cuts out the companies that take a cut of each payment.

questions.q: What drawback does the summary link to Bitcoin's anonymity?
a: Criminals can move money that law enforcement cannot trace
Governments can freeze any wallet at will
Users must reveal their identities to trade
Transfers take longer than bank payments
questions.why: Lesson 3 mentions Silk Road and the difficulty of investigating anonymous users.
